title: Company OKR alignment: initiative contracts, trajectory railmap, and escalation cadence
creator: Aisha Mendoza
description: Create a repeatable "initiative contract" and trajectory railmap that standardizes how company-level OKRs map to cross-functional initiatives. Deliverables: initiative contract template (owners, success metrics, milestones, rollback criteria), dependency registry pattern, escalation cadence, and Linear/Confluence templates. Provide a small pilot with two initiatives and a rollout plan for Q2. Goals: reduce cross-team rework, shorten decision latency, and make ripple impacts on dependent initiatives visible in planning cycles.
comments: 2025-01-12 — Kickoff with Eng, Design, and Strategy. Agreed scope: contract template + dependency registry + 2 pilot initiatives. Action: PM to draft first template by 1/20. Owner: Aisha.

2025-01-20 — Draft initiative contract posted to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.gg/display/OKR/initiative-contract-draft. Feedback: Engineering requests explicit SLO/rollback fields; Design asks for UX impact section. Assigned follow-ups.

2025-01-27 — Workshop with platform infra and reliability teams. Outcome: include 'capacity entitlement' field and mapping to Dedicated capacity releases. Note: track infra lead as dependency (ENG-8421).

2025-01-30 — Updated template v0.2 includes SLOs, rollback criteria, dependencies table, required dashboards, and release gate checklist. Shared in #pm-roadmap for asynchronous review. Link to doc: https://confluence.redwood.gg/display/OKR/initiative-contract-v0.2

2025-02-02 — Decision: pilot initiatives selected — 'Dedicated autoscale policies' and 'Console cost breakdown surface'. Each initiative owner to fill contract by 2/9. Action items: create Linear ticket templates & automation to attach contract to initiative (automation task assigned to Liam).

2025-02-02 — Next steps: build dependency registry as a Google Sheet prototype, then migrate to a lightweight Airtable view for visibility. Engineering to prototype an API-first dependency sync for release-agnostic visibility (follow-up ENG-9012).
notes: Pilot aims to validate that initiative contracts reduce cross-team clarifying meetings by 30% during planning sprint.
